scientific_interpretation: In GSE62928 biopsy data, 2/7 hub genes have concordant direction (binomial P = 0.4531). The fixed composite score has AUC = 0.4375 (one-sided Mann-Whitney P = 0.6571; two-sided P = 0.8857); the 1,000 random 7-gene-set null has mean AUC = 0.4798 and empirical P = 0.6040. The discovery effluent and validation biopsy cohorts differ in tissue and phenotype, limiting transportability. Historical synthetic validation outputs from the legacy pipeline are withdrawn.
